d: iOS to PS Vita port of Crash Nitro Kart
ld: An unofficial, native iOS-to-PS Vita wrapper port of Crash Bandicoot Nitro Kart 3D (iOS 1.0, originally developed by Polarbit on its Fuse engine). There is no .so here: the port ships its own Mach-O loader, which maps the original 32-bit ARMv6 iOS executable (iFuse) into Vita RAM and replaces the Apple frameworks it uses (Foundation/UIKit, OpenGL ES 1.1, AudioQueue) with native implementations built on vitaGL and the Vita system libraries. The game engine runs unmodified.
req:
- ur0:tai/kubridge.skprx
- Shader Compiler: libshacccg.suprx must be in ur0:data/ (extract it with ShaRKBR33D).
- Game Files: a decrypted Crash Bandicoot Nitro Kart 3D 1.0 .ipa
